benchmark.run.description: Run the fixed device benchmark in this browser.

benchmark.plainPathCheck.description: After the benchmark, time the same workload on the uninstrumented generation path and compare.

runtime.preview.description: Offers the preview runtime beside the hosted one. A visitor can turn the choice on with ?preview=runtime.preview; results made with it are marked.

views.experimental.description: Experimental views. A visitor can preview them with ?preview=views.experimental; nothing is published by doing so.

results.upload.description: Publishing a result. No upload service exists yet, and a page can never turn this on.

rankings.community.description: Rankings built from contributed results. Depends on results.upload and on an audited eligibility protocol.

voting.description: Human preference votes. No voting service exists yet.
